checkpoint.measurementModel: Adjacent segment join corrections for ordinary-aligned ranges; checkpoint-1 standalone graphemes for partial words.

checkpoint.scope: Preparation includes source/break analysis and fresh segment/grapheme measurement cache. Hot layout includes numeric exhaustive fitting and line records, no Flutter measurement.
